subject: Propeller Labs — request for 24h accelerant voucher for throughput validation
messages:
From: Ayesha Malik <ayesha@propeller.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Carter <alex@propeller.ai>, Procurement <procurement@propeller.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 24h accelerant voucher for throughput validation

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team (Alex and I) are lined up to run a 24-hour throughput sweep tonight to validate p95 and warm-start behavior across your dedicated instance. We've exhausted the trial pool and are seeing early throttling in the last 6 hours of our run. Can Redwood provision an ephemeral credit voucher to support a single 24h run (estimated 1.2M tokens, see attached expected-traffic.csv)?

Proposed timing: start 23:00 PDT tonight, duration ~24 hours. This is a one-off request tied to our POC acceptance criteria. If reasonable, Procurement can accept a short terms addendum.

Attachments: propeller_voucher_request_form.pdf, expected-traffic.csv

Appreciate a quick turnaround — this run is the last gating item before our internal exec review.

Best,
Ayesha Malik
Head of Platform Engineering
Propeller Labs
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ayesha Malik <ayesha@propeller.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 09:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 24h accelerant voucher for throughput validation

Ayesha —

Thanks for the clear ask and the traffic forecast. We can support a one-off voucher for a 24h throughput validation. I need a quick sign-off from billing for the promo allocation and an ops ticket to reserve capacity on the dedicated pool for that window so there are no surprises with routing/fallback.

Marissa / Ben — can you help with a $0 promo voucher for this POC and confirm we can reserve 4x T4d instances in us-west-2 between 23:00 PDT and 23:30 PDT tonight? If billing needs a PO or short terms addendum from Propeller, loop Procurement and I'll expedite.

Karthik
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 24h accelerant voucher for throughput validation

Karthik / team —

I can approve a promotional voucher for Propeller for this one-off POC run. Please confirm the exact voucher code length/format you want on the form — billing system needs the label to issue the voucher (e.g., PROPELLER-24H-XXXX). Also confirm expected token cap (Ayesha provided 1.2M tokens, please confirm if that's total or per-hour).

Jonas — I'll need a quick ops reservation. If you can't lock capacity we can offer an alternative time tonight, but prefer to keep the proposed window.

Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 24h accelerant voucher for throughput validation

Marissa / Karthik —

Confirmed: promo voucher approved (no charge) for Propeller Labs. Format: PROPELLER-24H-<4 alnum>. Token cap: 1,200,000 total for the run. I've created billing task #BILL-9814 to generate the voucher and attach usage limits.

Jonas — please create ops ticket and reserve 4x T4d equivalent nodes in us-west-2 for 23:00-24:00 PDT start window; allow for a 30m pre-warm. If capacity conflicts appear, notify me immediately and I'll coordinate re-routing approval.

Ben Carter
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

All set from ops side. Reserved capacity: 4x T4d-equivalent instances (us-west-2 dedicated pool) with a 30-minute warm window starting at 22:30 PDT. Billing has issued voucher: PROPELLER-24H-7K2Z. Voucher attached in the enterprise portal and pasted below for convenience. Please redeem via the console before your run starts.

Voucher: PROPELLER-24H-7K2Z
Token cap: 1,200,000 (total)
Valid window: 2028-04-04 23:00 PDT — 2028-04-05 23:00 PDT

Ops ticket: OPS-4521 (capacity reservation + pre-warm)
Billing task: BILL-9814
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4702/DP-2028-0791

If you hit any throttling or see unexpected p95 regressions, reply to this thread and we'll pause other background jobs and add headroom. Good luck — let us know how the p95 numbers look after the run.
